identity.title: Interactive Operator Cockpit MVP
identity.objective: Implement one local read-only FastAPI and React operator cockpit over validated WP169 market-truth and WP170 experiment evidence with bounded deterministic views and no authoritative writes, external product network, credentials, trading, or Hermes authority.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Karl explicitly authorizes WP171 as XL for scope budget only under V3 Section 7, up to the repository schema maximum of 35 exact paths. The frozen 26-path vertical slice covers backend, frontend, exact dependencies and lockfile, CI, focused tests, package evidence, repo truth, and narrow historical compatibility corrections without broadening product authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the WP171 branch. The local read-only cockpit, frontend, optional dependency group, lockfile, focused CI, tests, evidence artifacts, contract, and repo-truth updates disappear without changing WP169 or WP170 source, data, or any protected trading boundary.
